products.name: Rosemary Root Shampoo
products.short: Daily clarifying wash with rosemary leaf and pea sprout for a calm, light scalp.
products.howto: Massage into a wet scalp for 60 seconds, rinse, repeat if needed.
products.desc: Daily clarifying wash with rosemary leaf and pea sprout for a calm, light scalp.

products.name: Rice Water Repair Conditioner
products.short: Fermented rice water and oat protein smooth lengths without weighing them down.
products.howto: After shampoo, work through mid-lengths to ends, leave 2 minutes, rinse cool.
products.desc: Fermented rice water and oat protein smooth lengths without weighing them down.

products.name: Sea Buckthorn Shine Shampoo
products.short: A golden, gentle lather with sea buckthorn berry oil for glossy, bouncy hair.
products.howto: Lather between palms, wash, rinse. Follow with a conditioner.
products.desc: A golden, gentle lather with sea buckthorn berry oil for glossy, bouncy hair.

products.name: Aloe & Oat Gentle Shampoo
products.short: Soap-free, low-foam wash for sensitive scalps and everyday use.
products.howto: Use a coin-sized amount on wet hair, massage gently, rinse.
products.desc: Soap-free, low-foam wash for sensitive scalps and everyday use.

products.name: Camellia Pre-wash Oil
products.short: Cold-pressed camellia and bhringraj oil for a weekly scalp and length ritual.
products.howto: Warm 6–8 drops between fingers, massage into scalp and ends, leave 30 minutes, wash.
products.desc: Cold-pressed camellia and bhringraj oil for a weekly scalp and length ritual.

products.name: Shea Deep Repair Mask
products.short: A rich weekly mask with shea, mango butter and hydrolysed keratin-free proteins.
products.howto: Apply to towel-dried hair, comb through, leave 10 minutes, rinse well.
products.desc: A rich weekly mask with shea, mango butter and hydrolysed keratin-free proteins.

products.name: Peppermint Scalp Scrub
products.short: Fine sea salt and peppermint oil lift build-up before your shampoo.
products.howto: On a wet scalp, massage small amounts in circles, rinse, then shampoo.
products.desc: Fine sea salt and peppermint oil lift build-up before your shampoo.

products.name: Hibiscus Curl Cream
products.short: Defines curls and coils with hibiscus, flaxseed gel and a soft, touchable hold.
products.howto: Rake through soaking-wet hair in sections, scrunch, air-dry or diffuse.
products.desc: Defines curls and coils with hibiscus, flaxseed gel and a soft, touchable hold.

products.name: Neem & Tulsi Leave-in Mist
products.short: A weightless detangling mist with neem, tulsi and heat protection to 200°C.
products.howto: Mist over damp lengths, comb through, style as usual.
products.desc: A weightless detangling mist with neem, tulsi and heat protection to 200°C.

products.name: Root Ritual Trio
products.short: Travel trio: Rosemary Root Shampoo, Rice Water Conditioner and the Leave-in Mist.
products.howto: Shampoo, condition, mist. Fits a cabin bag.
products.desc: Travel trio: Rosemary Root Shampoo, Rice Water Conditioner and the Leave-in Mist.
